Definition: a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chittim or Kittim = "bruisers"; 1) a general term for all islanders of the Mediterranean Sea; 2) the descendants of Javan, the son of Japheth and grandson of Noah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
